summary: Price and volume moved unusually compared with this stock's own history.
text: Barclays raised its price target on Johnson & Johnson due to strength in key drugs, following an analysis of sales and prescription data [1]. Additionally, positive topline Phase 2b results for nipocalimab in systemic lupus erythematosus were announced [8].

sources.title: Barclays Raises Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Target on Strength in Key Drugs
Johnson & Johnson unveils new data showing nipocalimab is the first and only investigational FcRn blocker with potential to reduce systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) activity in a Phase 2 study
